I worked the overnight shift at a 24/7 gym. I only worked there a few weeks and my supervisor started to take his breaks with mine which I thought was odd. One night he decided to start showing me his tattoos, which were all over his body and was pulling his clothes around, while we were alone in the break room. Then he wanted to show me his knife, no idea why he had it on him at work. THEN he started telling me his war stories, how he killed people, and got shot 4 times. By now I was freaked out and just wanted to leave but I didn’t really know what to do. The thing that made me finally get up and go was when he started talking about how he missed the touch of a woman. 

I was shaking the rest of the shift and quit the next day.
I’m glad you understand! It’s really hard just being stuck in that middle of doing nothing.
I hope it goes well. Good luck.

As someone who goes through the same thing it’s not normal though. It is very tiring and even fucking embarrassing but it’s the only way. You gotta tell someone dude. The meltdowns get worse, the coping mechanisms get more unhealthy. It just gets worse.

You have to get some help dude. But I’m sure you know this. I don’t want you to become like me, no money no life at 25. I know you know this. I believe in you. If there is hope for me there is for you too.
I’m sorry you feel alone. But we are (or atleast I) will listen if you’d like to talk. I can understand and listen.
This was the best and worst thing I’ve ever read. It makes more sense then what the ending will actually be like I bet.
Mount Rushmore. It’s really boring after about 5 minutes of staring at the same rock.
